senses.gloss: रसना rasanā, f. often incorr. for रशना 🞄raśanā.

रास् RĀS, Ⅰ. rāsa, roar, yell, cry;
 intv. 🞄rārāsya, Ā. cry aloud.
रास् rā-s, aor. base of √ rā.
रसनायक rasa-nāyaka, m. ep. of Kāma.
रसनीय ras-anīya, fp. that which is tasted.
रसनेन्द्रिय rasana‿indriya, n. organ of taste.
रसास्वाद rasa‿āsvāda, m. perception of 🞄pleasure.

रस्य ras-ya, fp. that may be tasted;
 savoury.

राशीकृ rāśī-kṛ, make into a heap, heap 🞄up;
 -bhū, become a heap or accumulation, 🞄of (—˚).

राष्ट्री rā́ṣṭr-ī, f. female ruler, queen;
 -īya, 🞄m. kingʼs brother-in-law (in theatrical language).
रासभ rā́sa-bha, m. [√ rās] ass: ī, f. she-ass.
